description: § 172(a)(2)(B) 80% limit (derived). Single 2026, wages $216,100, post-2017 NOL carryover $350,000. Taxable income without the NOL deduction: 216,100 − 16,100 standard deduction = $200,000; deduction = min(350,000, 80% × 200,000) = $160,000 (Schedule 1 line 8a, negative). Taxable income $40,000.
